title: 第十二章 归真返璞第十三章 江东茂陵
slug: 自完美世界开始第2369章唐昊
content_zh:
随着使用历练点的念头落下，林阳就冥冥之中感觉到了什么，他眼前闪过一行文字。
“修炼《淬气决》，消耗一点历练点。”
眼前文字破碎，他的精神出现了一刹那的恍惚，脑海中多出一股记忆。
自己拿到了这本功法，日日夜夜不停钻研修炼，他感觉到有真气化生，分别经过了任督二脉，在上下颚凝聚成金津玉液，接着，又汇聚成了一滴清甜的甘露。
甘露慢慢地流过任脉，按照功法记载的那般，进入了自身窍穴。
无数个日日夜夜，也不知是多久，他终于把这本功法修炼到进无可进的圆满境地了，此刻，在开脉这一步，他称得上是完美二字。
“原来是这样，这比我自己修炼都完美的多的多。”
林阳恍然，哪怕自己修炼，也会因为这样那样的原因，出现种种耽误，比不得使用历练点，只有这个一个目标才是生命的意义。
果然神奇！
迫不及待的，林阳开始继续‘修炼’。
“修炼《八九玄功》蓄气篇，消耗五点历练点。”
蓄气篇才五点历练点？我有一个大胆的想法！
林阳忍不住喜上眉梢，这么便宜，他两百历练点岂不是直接上天？
那种恍惚感再次袭来，这次是自己不停钻研着《八九玄功》蓄气篇的奥秘，仿佛有一股股道音，为他讲解修炼此功的种种关隘，怎么样才能圆满无缺。
感官上辨别不出时间，也不知道具体是过去多久，他终于将八九玄功的蓄气篇，修炼到最圆满。可称他此刻的境界为‘蓄气大圆满’，于常规的蓄气大成之上，再走出两步。也不知古时有没有人到过此境界，但是当今之世，想来是绝无仅有。
“哎，修炼一路，有的靠根骨，有的靠体质，有的靠悟性，有的靠嗑药，我也只是靠一下机缘。”
林阳想着想着不禁哈哈大笑起来，他感觉未来一片光明，前途无量。
“修炼《八九玄功》开窍篇！”
“《八九玄功》开窍篇可修炼八个阶段，一次二十历练点”
“我就知道一下子上天是不可能。”

林阳哀叹一声，还好，历练点足够。
刚准备一口气来个八连击，就打消了念头，他还有剑法掌法轻功为学，光是境界高了，遇上同等级的还是会吃亏。
“修炼《独孤九剑》《天山折梅手》。”
“总计消耗四十历练点。”
还好没有出现个可强化次数。
林阳松了一口气。
这一次可能是因为一次性选择两本功法，林阳感觉同时有两股记忆涌入脑海，最神奇的是互不影响，他本以为会出现诸如记忆错乱的后遗症之类的，结果是他想多了。
content_en:
As the thought of using the experience points fell, Lin Yang felt something in the dark, and a line of text flashed before his eyes.
"Practice "Qi Tempering Jue" and consume some experience points."
The words in front of him were broken, and his mind was in a trance for a moment, and there was a memory in his mind.
He got this skill book and studied it day and night. He felt that the true energy was transformed, passed through the two meridians of Ren and Du, and condensed into Jinjinyuye on the upper and lower jaws, and then gathered into a drop of sweet nectar.
The nectar slowly flows through the Ren channel and enters one's own acupoints as recorded in the exercise method.
After countless days and nights, and no one knows how long it took, he finally practiced this technique to a point of perfection where there was no further progress. At this moment, in the step of opening the pulse, he could be called perfect.
"So that's it. It's much more perfect than even my own cultivation."
Lin Yang suddenly realized that even if he practiced by himself, there would be various delays due to various reasons, and he would not be able to use his experience points. This is the only goal that is the meaning of life.
It's amazing!
Impatiently, Lin Yang began to continue 'cultivation'.
"Practice the Qi Accumulation Chapter of "Eight-Nine Mysterious Skills" and consume five experience points."
The Qi Gathering Chapter only has five experience points? I have a bold idea!
Lin Yang couldn't help but feel happy. It was so cheap. Wouldn't his two hundred experience points go directly to the sky?
That sense of trance came over again. This time, he was studying the secrets of the Qi Accumulation Chapter of "Eight-Nine Mysterious Techniques", as if there were Taoist voices explaining to him the various hurdles of practicing this technique and how to achieve perfection.
Unable to distinguish the time with his senses, and not knowing exactly how much time had passed, he finally practiced the Qi Accumulation Chapter of the Eight-Nine Mysterious Techniques to perfection. His current state can be called the 'Qi Accumulation Dzogchen', which is two more steps beyond the conventional Qi Accumulation Dacheng. I don’t know if anyone has been to this realm in ancient times, but in today’s world, I think it is unique.
"Hey, along the way of cultivation, some rely on bones, some rely on physical fitness, some rely on understanding, and some rely on taking drugs. I just rely on chance."
Lin Yang couldn't help laughing as he thought about it. He felt that the future was bright and boundless.
"Practice the enlightenment chapter of "Eight-Nine Mysterious Techniques"!"
"The opening chapter of "Eight-Nine Mysterious Skills" can be practiced in eight stages, with twenty experience points at a time."
"I knew it would be impossible to go to heaven all at once."
Lin Yang lamented, okay, the experience is enough.
Just when he was about to hit eight consecutive blows in one go, he gave up the idea. He also had swordsmanship, palm skills, and Qinggong as a training. Even if his level was high, he would still suffer when he met someone of the same level.
"Practice "Dugu Nine Swords" and "Tianshan Plum Blossom Hand".
"A total of forty experience points were consumed."
Fortunately, there are no times that can be strengthened.
Lin Yang breathed a sigh of relief.
This time, it may be because he chose two skills at once. Lin Yang felt that two memories were flooding into his mind at the same time. The most amazing thing was that they did not affect each other. He originally thought that there would be sequelae such as memory confusion, but it turned out that he was overthinking.
